Throughport WMS

Smart warehouse management system for traceability and inventory control

Throughport is a cloud-connected warehouse management system designed for logistics operations that need real-time inventory traceability, goods-in/goods-out tracking, and operational dashboards.

Problem: Warehouses lose stock, misplace inventory, and have zero visibility into throughput and movements.

Features: Inventory tracking, Goods-in/goods-out, Barcode/QR scanning, Real-time dashboards, Audit trail, IoT integration.

Target users: Warehouse managers, logistics operations, manufacturing facilities, distribution centers.

Who is Throughport WMS for? Warehouse managers, logistics operations, manufacturing facilities, distribution centers

What problem does this product solve? Warehouses lose stock, misplace inventory, and have zero visibility into throughput and movements.

Can AICORE customise this product? Yes. AICORE can adapt product workflows, integrations, dashboards, user roles, and deployment details around your organisation's requirements.
